name: Leadership Quality Assessment

fields.label: Quality
fields.description: What is being judged — one quality per row, from the governed list (migration 019).

fields.label: Basis / evidence
fields.description: What the assessment rests on. At least one of assessor, date or evidence is required.

description: One leadership judgement about a person, with its basis. The source keeps these in `commander_trait` and then `person_trait` (migrations 019/020); a judgement about a person is owned by that person, so it is a child table of Person here.
